profile.name: Teerth Sharma
profile.hero: A seal companion lives at the center of a snowy ice world. Touch the igloo, then move through Teerth's systems, topology work, and upstream evidence.
profile.manifesto: Topology is the operating system: kernels, ML fields, QPU proof, and upstream code compiled into one polar machine.
profile.signal: topology, ML fields, kernels, QPU proof, and upstream code compiled into one polar machine

stations.name: Seal OS Cavern
stations.signal: Microkernel, ManifoldFS, theorem gates, boot proof
stations.description: Kernel and runtime work: Epsilon-Hollow, Rust systems code, manifold-aware filesystems, and proof-linked boot discipline.

stations.name: Aether Reactor
stations.signal: Persistent homology, compiler runtime, verified kernels
stations.description: Aether-Lang turns topology into program structure: neighborhoods, manifold embeddings, and kernels built for topology-aware computation.

stations.name: Field Chamber
stations.signal: Fixed-point fields, gauge language, N-body coupling
stations.description: Faraday and Hamilton explore electromagnetic fields, gauge notation, fixed-point projection, and topology-aware physical coupling.

stations.name: Quantum Bridge
stations.signal: Homology-backed quantum information and QPU evidence
stations.description: TopoBridge-Q and Aether-Link connect homology, quantum information, IBM QPU runs, and high-performance I/O evidence.

stations.name: Upstream Orbit
stations.signal: Triton, PyTorch, NeMo-Relay, Docker Agent, graph systems
stations.description: Public upstream work: topology-derived sparse attention, ACG cache prefixes, graph systems, and experimental PyTorch/Triton patches.

stations.name: Topology Archive
stations.signal: TDA memory, topology visualization, audio/TTS, phase space
stations.description: The long tail: lambda-topo, topoflow, topoml, phi-mem, audio systems, and topology-first experiments with source traces.
